trace.final:
Summary of actions taken:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.0 was the most recent version that had been healthy in production.

**Remediation:**
1. Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially applied (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error; I retried and completed the rollout to all regions.
2. Verified post-rollback state: v2.3.0 is live in us-east, us-west, and eu-west, service is healthy, and error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy," documenting the v2.3.1 failures, the rollback to v2.3.0 across all regions (including the partial-apply orchestrator error), and the recovered health status. The incident is open and has paged the on-call engineer.

**Follow-up note:** The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator error during rollback are worth investigating before any further deploys.
